summary: Every activity duration can change one age bucket's percentages, so all activity rows must be inspected and one grouped aggregation matches that linear lower bound.

optimality.argument: Any unread activity may change a category numerator and the bucket denominator, establishing Omega(n); hash-based joining and grouping aggregate every row once in expected O(n) time.

replacement_checks.evidence: Changing the duration or type of any activity can alter its age bucket's returned percentages.
A user-to-bucket lookup and one conditional grouped aggregation process each activity once.
Cases cover the official sample, multiple users per bucket, one-category buckets, fractional durations, and bucket isolation.
